changes: Increased the base Shiny rate from 1 in 8,192 to 1 in 512.
Upgraded the game engine to pokeemerald-expansion 1.16.3 and enabled follower Pokémon.
Made every regular Pokémon and regional form obtainable, with remaining special cases added to the Bean Shop.
Added a postgame Legendary Lottery Island and dozens of Mega Stones to discover across Hoenn.
Reworked all eight Trick House puzzles with 32 region-themed Elite Four cameos, matching sprites, music, and dialogue.
Added new Ace Trainer boss battles and postgame challengers around Hoenn.
Fixed key progression issues involving starters, time-based evolutions, and Nuzlocke catches.
Published the first official release of Pokémon Black Pearl Emerald.
Introduced a reworked Emerald adventure with custom trainer teams, sprites, dialogue, maps, and music.
Added expanded Pokémon content and modern battle mechanics through pokeemerald-expansion 1.8.6.
Added the Bean Shop, Lilycove event-ticket ferry, and expanded legendary encounters.
Improved egg and daycare behavior and polished graphics throughout the game.
